Initial public release of the `openremap` core library.

Patch release with two main areas of work: extractor correctness for Opel, PSA/Citroën, and Porsche binaries discovered during a corpus audit; and a rework of the CLI commands including two new commands (`commands`, `families`), renamed `validate` sub-commands, and a rebuilt one-shot `tune` workflow.
Terminal User Interface, smart entry-point dispatch, scan improvements, new Bosch M4.x / MP9 extractors, and extractor hardening across the board.
Siemens, Delphi, and Magneti Marelli manufacturer support; Bosch ME1.5.5; manufacturer-aware confidence scoring; README rewrite; `.remap` recipe extension; T…
EDC16 hardware-number extraction fix, evidence-based detection system, confidence scoring reframed as identification quality, and documentation consistency pass.
Flat package layout, Python 3.10 minimum compatibility, README and docs refresh, TUI syntax fix, and test reliability fix.
Recipe safety guards, instruction annotation (VIN detection), patcher collision safety, recipe provenance & fingerprinting, and full CLI/TUI surfacing of all new signals.
Recipe format 4.3 — schema restructure, creator simplification, and metadata expansion. Breaking changes from 4.2 are limited to the recipe format itself; th…
Rust native extension with PyO3 + maturin, hybrid dispatch, and automated multi-platform wheel publishing.
Rust source directory rename and release pipeline fixes.
Rust map hunter — `scan_map_axes` and `scan_map_tables` ported to Rust with 26× speedup, plus a new `scan-maps` CLI command for structural calibration map discovery.
Shared-axis detection, scoring refinements, speed-based deduplication of the Rust/Python backends, and musl wheels for Alpine Docker.
Speed-based backend deduplication — every function lives in exactly one language, chosen by benchmark.
Milestone release — see the summary in `CHANGELOG.md`.
